definitions.automatic_pool_insertions: One kind=promotion record in the automatic-promotion journal; counts program/context insertion events, not independent adapter gains or distinct programs across contexts.
definitions.adapter_rejected: One minus the accepted flag in each admission record, cross-checked against the per-round observer.
definitions.windowing: Nonoverlapping consecutive windows of20 completed rounds, beginning3174; retain final partial window. Empty event counts denote zero recorded promotion events within the captured complete journal prefix.

source_binding: Logged aggregate fields only; installed loop source, adapter, evaluation population and normalization closure remain unqualified.
scope: Adaptive training-side program insertion events and development-side adapter decisions have distinct units. No independent first-proposal, learning-gain, writer/ranking-map benefit or serving comparison.
